reuse.why: Changes the rule inside the existing getExpectedScheduleAmount, keeping getApproxNumberThreshold for the tolerance, so every caller (including getScheduledAmount) picks it up.

duplication.why: No logic is added outside the shared function; the call sites only get comment updates.

placement.why: The rule stays in shared/schedules.ts where the tree already defines the expected schedule amount.

scope.why: One rule edit, matching tests, comment refreshes and a release note.

maintainability.why: A one-line Math.min rule with a clear doc comment; the per-site comments restating the rule (and the callers' own number/null dispatch, pre-existing) remain places that can go stale.

bypasses_abstraction.where: The diff only edits the shared helper; no new path computes the amount itself.
